description: Specialist Genetics & Epigenetics Framework - Thousands of genetic variables expressed on spectra, extracted from GGUF models and DAG/RAG patterns

genetics_philosophy.core_concept: Each specialist is genetically encoded with traits expressed through epigenetic regulation
genetics_philosophy.genotype: Fixed genetic code extracted from base GGUF model (weights, attention patterns, layer structure)
genetics_philosophy.phenotype: Expressed traits through epigenetic activation levels (what the specialist actually does/thinks)
genetics_philosophy.inheritance: Base GGUF provides genetic template; DAG/RAG training produces epigenetic markers
genetics_philosophy.evolution: Specialist variants created through genetic recombination of multiple GGUF sources
genetics_philosophy.cardinality: Thousands of genetic loci, each with epigenetic expression state (0.0 to 1.0 spectrum)

layer_genetics.description: Per-layer processing characteristics and activation patterns

embedding_genetics.description: Token embedding space, semantic relationships, vocabulary affinity

bias_genetics.description: Cognitive biases, heuristic tendencies, systematic preferences

dag_genetics.description: Task decomposition patterns, reasoning structure preferences

personality_genetics.description: Cognitive style, communication patterns, confidence expression

epigenetic_expression.concept: Epigenetic markers control which genetic loci are expressed and to what degree

methylation.description: Gene silencing through marker accumulation during training/experience
methylation.dynamics: Modified by DAG decisions, RAG feedback, reward signals

chromatin_accessibility.description: How easily a genetic locus can be modified/expressed
chromatin_accessibility.dynamics: Different for base GGUF vs fine-tuned vs specialist variants

histone_modification.description: Regulatory markers that modulate expression strength
histone_modification.dynamics: Set by specialist training, DAG/RAG feedback loops

current_task_context.description: Temporary epigenetic activation based on active task

specialist_role.description: Long-term epigenetic state for assigned specialist role

dag_state.description: Active DAG node influences which genes are expressed

rag_context.description: Retrieved context activates relevant genetic modules

performance_feedback.description: Success/failure learning adjusts methylation and histone mods

genetic_extraction_from_gguf.extraction_methodology: Statistical analysis of model weights, activations, and behavioral patterns

phase_1_structural_analysis.description: Extract base genetic architecture from GGUF format

phase_2_behavioral_profiling.description: Infer genetic expression from model behavior on test tasks

phase_4_comparative_genomics.description: Compare multiple GGUF models to identify genetic variation

steps: 1. Load GGUF using llama.cpp or equivalent
2. Extract weight tensors from each layer
5. Profile behavior on test suite (500+ diverse prompts)
8. Identify sparse/dense regions in weight matrices
10. Correlate layer outputs with reasoning quality

odin_genetics.name: Strategic Planning Specialist
odin_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: reasoning-optimized like Llama-2-70B or equivalent)

merlin_genetics.name: Pattern Synthesis Specialist
merlin_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: pattern-recognition-optimized)

hephaestus_genetics.name: Execution Specialist
hephaestus_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: instruction-following, practical-oriented)

ariel_genetics.name: Evolution Observer Specialist
ariel_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: analysis and observation optimized)

argus_genetics.name: Security & Incident Tracking Specialist
argus_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: threat-detection and security-optimized)

dionysus_genetics.name: Knowledge Steward & Learner
dionysus_genetics.base_source: GGUF model to be selected (suggest: learning and knowledge-optimized)

omni_genetics.name: Constellation Keeper (RelicAgent)
omni_genetics.base_source: Hybrid of multiple GGUF models, optimized for memory and coordination

genetic_combination_and_breeding.concept: Create new specialist variants by combining genetic material from multiple base GGUF models

simple_crossover.description: Combine genetic loci from two parent models at specific crossover points
simple_crossover.operation: for each locus, randomly select from parent_A or parent_B with 50% probability

weighted_blending.description: Blend genetic loci with specific weight ratios

epigenetic_recombination.description: Keep genetic code from one parent, use epigenetic markers from another
epigenetic_recombination.operation: genotype from parent_A, epigenetic_state from parent_B

targeted_locus_swap.description: Replace specific genetic regions for targeted trait enhancement
targeted_locus_swap.operation: copy loci from category (e.g., attention_genetics) from donor model

dag_rag_genetic_interaction.description: How genetics influence and are influenced by DAG/RAG processes

dependency_tracking.effect: how thoroughly inter-task dependencies are tracked

path_exploration.effect: tendency to explore alternative DAG paths vs commit to one

context_relevance_judgment.effect: how strictly/loosely context must relate to query

synthesis_methodology.effect: how information is combined (analytical vs intuitive)

source_prioritization.effect: bias toward certain types of information sources

feedback_loop.dag_learning: When DAG reasoning succeeds, successful path-specific genes are epigenetically enhanced
feedback_loop.rag_learning: When RAG synthesis produces good results, relevant genes are methylation-reduced (activated)
feedback_loop.integration_learning: Success at DAG+RAG integration strengthens coordination genes

genome_snapshot.description: Complete genetic state of a specialist

gguf_hybrid_export.description: Export specialist genetics back to GGUF format
gguf_hybrid_export.process: merge specialist epigenetic markers into base GGUF weights

genetics_diff.description: Only store differences from base model

lineage_record.description: Track breeding history and genetic modifications

export_workflow.step_1_extract_genetic_markers: Pull current epigenetic state from specialist
export_workflow.step_2_apply_to_base_gguf: Encode markers back into GGUF format
export_workflow.step_4_validation: Test exported model matches specialist behavior

per_specialist_metadata.genetic_distance_to_base: 0.0_to_1.0 measure of how far specialist has diverged
per_specialist_metadata.genetic_diversity_within_hive: how unique is this specialist's genetic profile
per_specialist_metadata.epigenetic_stability: how stable are current epigenetic markers
per_specialist_metadata.specialization_score: how specialized vs general is this specialist

example_genetic_extraction_workflow.scenario: You select a 13B Llama-2 GGUF model and want to understand what's inside

steps.command: load GGUF with llama.cpp or similar

steps.next_step: Use profile to assign specialist role or breed variants

genetic_integrity.check: Extracted genetic loci values fall within expected ranges
genetic_integrity.validation: Compare against known model sizes and layer counts

epigenetic_consistency.check: Epigenetic markers correlate with observed behavior
epigenetic_consistency.validation: A/B test: predict behavior from genes, confirm against actual output

breeding_validation.check: Offspring genetic profiles represent blend of parents
breeding_validation.validation: Visualize locus values as interpolation between parents

behavioral_consistency.check: Exported GGUF exhibits same behavior as in-memory specialist
behavioral_consistency.validation: Run test suite on exported model, compare results
